case_name: International Asset Reconstruction Company of India Limited and another v Official Liquidator of Aldrich Pharmaceuticals Limited and another
petitioner: International Asset Reconstruction Company of India Limited and another
respondent:
Official Liquidator of Aldrich Pharmaceuticals Limited and another
Supreme Court of India

24 October 2017
Civil Appeal No. 16962 of 2017 (Arising out of SLP (C) No. 25815 of 2013) with Civil Appeal No. 16963 of 2017 (Arising out of SLP (C) No. 29534 of 2014)
The Judgment was delivered by : Navin Sinha, J.
1. Leave granted.
2. A common question of law arising for consideration in both appeals is whether Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 (hereinafter referred to as "the Limitation Act"), can be invoked to condone the prescribed period of 30 days, under Section 30(1) of the Recovery of Debts and Bankruptcy Act, 1993 (hereinafter referred as the "RDB Act"), for preferring an appeal before the Tribunal, against an order of the Recovery officer.
3. In view of the pure question of law involved, the facts of the case need not be elucidated. Suffice to observe that pursuant to a recovery certificate issued by the Tri

statutes.act: Read With Section 24 Of The Rdb Act

holding: The prescribed period of 30 days under Section 30(1) of the RDB Act for preferring an appeal against the order of the Recovery officer therefore cannot be condoned by application of Section 5 of the Limitation Act.
